steps.title: Verify astrocyte purity
steps.instruction: Confirm that microglia and OPCs have been removed from the culture; if not, follow the appropriate protocols to obtain a pure astrocyte culture.

steps.title: Discard old media
steps.instruction: Remove the culture media from the flask and discard it.

steps.title: Rinse and trypsinize cells
steps.instruction: Rinse the flask twice with PBS, aspirate the PBS, add 5 mL of 0.05 % trypsin‑EDTA, and place the flask in a CO₂ incubator at 37 °C. Check cell detachment every 5 min and, if needed, tap the flask against the palm of your hand 2–3 times to promote detachment.

substeps.instruction: Rinse the flask twice with PBS.
Incubate in a CO₂ incubator at 37 °C.
If cells remain attached, tap the flask against the palm 2–3 times.

steps.title: Inactivate trypsin with media
steps.instruction: After the astrocytes have detached, add 5 mL of astrocyte culture media to the flask to neutralize the trypsin.

steps.title: Prepare trypan blue cell count
steps.instruction: Take a 1.5 mL microtube that already contains 10 µL of trypan blue, add 10 µL of the cell suspension, load 10 µL of this mixture onto a hemacytometer, and examine immediately under a low‑magnification microscope.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve a 1.5 mL microtube pre‑filled with 10 µL trypan blue.
Add 10 µL of cell suspension to the tube and mix gently.
Load 10 µL of the trypan‑blue‑cell mixture onto a hemacytometer.
Observe the hemacytometer immediately under low magnification.

steps.title: Count viable cells and calculate concentration
steps.instruction: Count the white (viable) cells, then calculate viable cells per milliliter using the formula: viable cells × 10⁴ = cells/mL, correcting for any dilution factor.

steps.title: Pellet cells and add RNA shield
steps.instruction: Transfer the calculated volume of cell suspension to microtubes to obtain ~2 × 10⁵ cells per well, spin at 180 × g for 5 min, aspirate the supernatant, add 50 µL of Zymo 1× DNA/RNA Shield, and resuspend the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the appropriate volume of cell suspension to achieve ~2 × 10⁵ cells per well.
Centrifuge the tubes at 180 × g for 5 min.
Add 50 µL of Zymo 1× DNA/RNA Shield to each pellet.

steps.title: Vortex viscous lysate if needed
steps.instruction: If the lysed cell solution appears highly viscous, vortex it vigorously for about 30 seconds to shear chromosomal DNA.

steps.title: Transfer lysate to labeled tubes
steps.instruction: Move the prepared supernatant into properly labeled 200 µL strip tubes or a 96‑well plate following the instructions on https://plasmidsaurus.com/sample-prep/rna#section1.
